name: 喻沐英
objective:
本課主旨在設計課程，提供練習，俾使學生嫻熟各式的英語測驗，如全民英檢、托福測驗、TOEIC 測驗或類似性質的測驗，希冀能夠藉由本課程的修習，提升學生不斷的學習外國語的興致，並且，藉由通過考試取得證照，增加未來職場的競爭力。
This course is designed to familiarize the students with various kinds of language proficiency tests such as GEPT, TOEFL, TOEIC and many others to the same end. It is our hope that the students who finish taking the course will go on with their enthusiasm on studying foreign languages; besides, through the acquisition of the certificate when the students pass the tests, they are sure to enhance their capability in the increasingly competitive job markets.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1 Course Introduction
Week 2 Film-Based English Learning 
              (The Family Plan)
Week 3 Test
Week 4 English through TV Series
Week 5 Test
Week 6 Career Interview Project
Week 7 Test
Week 8 Independent Learning
Week 9 English through Songs
Week 10 Test
Week 11 Career Interview Presentations I
Week 12 Career Interview Presentations II
Week 13 Media English and Popular Culture
Week 14 Course Wrap-up and Reflection
Week 15 Test
Week 16 Independent Learning
Week 17. Flexible learning activities
Week 18. Independent learning
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          本課程透過多元且貼近真實情境的教材與任務導向活動，提升學生英語聽力、口說及語言測驗能力。課程內容涵蓋電影、影集、歌曲、媒體英語及職涯相關主題，並結合聽力練習、小組討論、口頭發表及自主學習等活動，培養學生實際運用英語溝通的能力。課程並安排定期測驗與專題發表，以檢視學生的學習成效與語言能力發展
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          4
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          學生的學習成果將透過測驗、課堂參與、自主學習、小組討論、口頭簡報及作業等方式進行評量，以了解學生在英語聽力、口語表達、字彙運用及語言測驗能力等方面的學習成效與進步情形。
Students' learning outcomes will be evaluated through quizzes, classroom participation, independent learning tasks, group discussions, oral presentations, and reflective learning activities. Mid-course and final assessments will measure students' progress in English listening, speaking, vocabulary development, and test-taking abilities.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          Independent / Flexible Learning：10%
